name: Tainted Letter
summary: Drusilla La Salle sends the Tainted Letter to human warlock initiates near Northshire Abbey. It bears her seal and directs them to seek her tutelage discreetly.

sections.title: A Covert Summons
sections.body: The Tainted Letter bears Drusilla La Salle’s insignia and reaches initiates returning from nearby kobold camps. While priests, paladins, and soldiers train openly across Northshire Abbey’s lawns, fel practitioners must keep their path quiet. The letter directs novice warlocks to find their mentor near the abbey grounds without drawing the notice of town guards or clerics.

sections.title: The Price of Ambition
sections.body: Drusilla La Salle meets her pupils on the fringes, where sentries are less likely to pry. Elwynn’s ordinary folk distrust warlocks, so the letter begins a lesson in discipline. Arcane and nether magic bring the risk of corruption. Those who commune with denizens of the Twisting Nether must temper ambition with patient self-control.

faq.answer: Drusilla La Salle, the warlock trainer near Northshire Abbey, sent the letter.

faq.q: Why is the letter considered tainted?
faq.answer: The letter bears Drusilla La Salle’s insignia and traces of fel magic, marking it as the work of a practitioner of demonic arts.

faq.q: Why are Northshire guards watching Drusilla La Salle?
faq.answer: Northshire’s guards and priests distrust fel magic and demonic summoning. Drusilla keeps to the abbey’s outskirts to avoid the authorities’ close watch.

faq.q: What advice does Drusilla give upon reading the letter?
faq.answer: Drusilla warns that dealing with entities from the Twisting Nether brings temptation and corruption. She urges her pupils to use self-control and prudence while holding to their ambition.

angles.text: As a warlock, you receive the Tainted Letter as your introduction to the shadowy craft in the Kingdom of Stormwind. Power over the Nether calls for constant vigilance and discretion.
As a human, you live in a society that broadly champions the Holy Light. Practitioners of dark magic train in secret on the margins of places like Northshire Abbey.
